mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, DIFFICULTY, DESCRIPTION, PRICE, STOCK, IMAGE, CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY PRODUCT_ID
SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, DIFFICULTY, DESCRIPTION, PRICE, STOCK, IMAGE, CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT PRODUCT_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY, DIFFICULTY, DESCRIPTION, PRICE, STOCK, IMAGE ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{productName}, #{category}, #{difficulty}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{image} )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET PRODUCT_NAME = #{productName}, CATEGORY = #{category}, DIFFICULTY = #{difficulty}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, PRICE = #{price}, STOCK = #{stock}, IMAGE = #{image} WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
